description: Medical Bill Upcoding & Overcharge Slasher — Paste an itemized hospital or physician bill and get a decision first: dispute it or not, the estimated dollars above a defensible price, and a dispute letter ready to send. Flags E/M upcoding, NCCI unbundling, duplicates and unit errors line by line, prices professional claims against the CMS physician fee schedule, checks the No Surprises Act self-pay dispute deadline, and lists the letter's pla

billReceivedDate.description: Date the initial bill was received; used for the 120-day dispute deadline.

billText.description: Alternative to lineItems: paste the itemized bill, one line item per line, e.g. "99285  EMERGENCY DEPT VISIT LVL 5   1   $3,250.00". Lines with a CPT/HCPCS code and a dollar amount are read in code; send exactly one of lineItems or billText.

claimType.description: Physician (CMS-1500) or hospital/facility (UB-04) bill. Medicare physician fee schedule benchmarks apply only to professional claims.

coverage.description: Determines which No Surprises Act protections can apply.

chargedAmount.description: Total billed for this line, USD.

cptOrHcpcsCode.description: 5-character CPT or HCPCS Level II code.

visitSummary.description: What actually happened: symptoms, duration, tests, treatment.

name: medical-bill-auditor
